notes: Job LOADPADB step STEP01 (DFSRRC00 PARM='BMP,PAUDBLOD,PSBPAUTB'): a BMP. PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IO-PCB-MASK PAUTBPCB, then ENTRY 'DLITCBL' USING PAUTBPCB lists only the DB PCB -- IMS passes the I/O PCB first (PSB PSBPAUTB, CMPAT=YES), so the ENTRY list is the division's list minus its first (#5233). It loads the empty pending-authorization database DBPAUTP0 (HIDAM: root PAUTSUM0, child PAUTDTL1) with CALL 'CBLTDLI' ISRT from INFILE1 (the roots) and INFILE2 (each child behind its root's key: GU the root, then ISRT the child). INFILE1 / INFILE2 are not in the corpus: generated from the program's own record layouts, INFILE1's last PA-ACCT-ID repeats the first (ISRT root -> II) and INFILE2's ROOT-SEG-KEY cycles over INFILE1's keys plus one with no root (GU miss); keys are positive because the CBLTDLI model refuses a P-field qualification whose operands are not both valid with one positive sign. The I/O PCB mask is PIC X(1) here and the program never reads it (the same ASSUMPTION as CBPAUP0C). The DL/I model is register family I (tests/equivalence/ims/ggdli.c, cobolrt/dli/DetDli.java), #4893. faults.why: 30: a permanent error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): OPEN INPUT INFILE1 fails: 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE1' and 9999-ABEND before any DL/I call

faults.name: infile2-open
faults.why: 30: a permanent error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): OPEN INPUT INFILE2 fails after INFILE1 opened: 'ERROR IN OPENING INFILE2' and 9999-ABEND

faults.name: infile1-read-error
faults.why: 30: a permanent error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) on the third root READ: neither blank/00 nor 10, so 'ERROR READING ROOT SEG INFILE' and the loop goes on to the next record (the program's defect: no abend)

faults.name: infile2-read-error
faults.why: 30: a permanent error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) on the third child READ: 'ERROR READING CHILD SEG INFILE' and the loop goes on

faults.name: infile1-close

faults.name: infile2-close
faults.why: 30: a permanent error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) closing INFILE2: 'ERROR IN CLOSING 2ND FILE'

faults.name: root-isrt-fail
faults.why: #5233: the first root ISRT answers AM (neither blank nor II): ROOT INSERT FAILED and 9999-ABEND (RC 16) with nothing loaded

faults.name: child-gu-fail
faults.why: #5233: the first root GU (qualified by the child's root key) answers AM instead of blank / GE: the child ISRT is not tried and the load goes on to the next child record

faults.name: child-isrt-dup
faults.why: #5233: the first child ISRT (the 12th ISRT of the run, after the 11 root inserts) answers II: CHILD SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB and the load goes on

faults.name: child-isrt-fail
faults.why: #5233: the first child ISRT answers AM (neither blank nor II): INSERT CALL FAIL FOR CHILD and 9999-ABEND (RC 16) with the 11 roots loaded and no child
